name: AK33 - Handheld Indoor Air Quality Monitor (CO2, TVOC, HCHO, PM1.0, PM2.5, PM10, Temperature, Humidity, AQI), Data Logging, 173g
highlights: History On Board, No Phone Required — The device stores its own record. Where a Bluetooth model needs a paired handset in the room, this one logs whether anyone is there or not — and hands the record over later.
173 g and 25 mm Thick — The lightest device in the range that measures all eight parameters. It reads like an instrument in the hand rather than an ornament on a desk.
Built for Walking a Building — Survey several rooms in sequence, then read back where the levels changed. That is a workflow a spot-reading monitor cannot support.
2500 mAh, Six Hours — Four hours to full over USB-C; 173 g in the hand.
For Consultants and Facilities Teams — Where a report has to name rooms and times, on-board history is the difference between a finding and a recollection.
